blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Office of the Vice President (OVP) has recognized Liloan’s Bagyong Tino “hero,” Jayboy Magdadaro, with the Gawad Makabansa Award. He gained public attention after rescuing over 50 residents in Liloan, Cebu, who were caught in dangerous floodwaters during the onslaught of Typhoon Tino last November 2025. His actions underscored the importance of solidarity and the willingness to help others during disasters.
